info.name: Smart Calling Service — Full Dashboard API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for all dashboard APIs:
- Auth
- Saler Dashboard
- Manager Dashboard
- Admin Dashboard
- Auditor Dashboard
- Support Dashboard

Start by running **Auth > Sign In** to auto-capture the JWT access token.

request.description: Saves access token to {{access_token}} collection variable automatically.
